svg.text: Comprehensive Side-by-Side Benchmark: Decompression & Compression Throughput and Ratios
Evaluated across 31 public datasets + 6 industrial scenarios (Metrics calculated using Geometric Mean)
Covering IoT telemetry, physical trends, quant finance, steady constants, geospatial, and public macro

g.text: Source: NEON Ecological Network / Meteoblue Archive
Source: Industrial PID Loops / Water Stage Gauges
Source: Redundant Sensor Heartbeats / Normal Monitors
Source: Satellite Avian Tracking / Kaggle POI Database
Source: UN World Food Programme / CWI Gov Benchmarks
Note: Overall decode/encode speeds and compression ratios are calculated using Geometric Mean across all 37 benchmarks and industrial scenarios.
Measured directly on Apple M2 Max with C++ ALP fork (github.com/x-at-01/ALP) in full end-to-end mode.
Strictly guarantees 100% exact bitwise IEEE 754 lossless reproduction.
